_comment: Paper-1 params for VAAL (ADR 0015) on DATA/daninhas_full_fixed/ (ADR 0016): identical to params_paper1.json plus an explicit strategy_args.VAAL block: the defaults of dalmax.config.schema.VAALArgs (DeepAL+/original VAAL: 30 VAE/discriminator epochs per query over the joint labeled/unlabeled loader, latent 32, beta 1, adversary weight 1, 2 VAE steps and 1 discriminator step per batch, Adam lr 5e-4) except image_size = 32: the 128 x 128 images are area-resized to 32 x 32 for the VAE (author's cost decision 2026-11-11, about 4x cheaper than the default 64; the VAE supports any multiple of 16). The task model is trained exactly as for every other strategy. See .specs/adr/0015-deepalplus-strategies.md and .specs/adr/0016-clean-rerun-fixed-dataset.md.
